line: Crowley's Prince of Swords: Vau of the Name (pdf p139); the airy part of Air and the span from Capricornus to Aquarius (pdf p161).

sections.title: The court and its element
sections.line: Crowley on the Princes (pdf p139) and on the Prince of Swords (pdf p161).

quotes.quote: The Princes represent the Forces of the letter Vau in the Name.
This card represents the airy part of Air.

sections.title: Its span in the Zodiac
sections.line: Crowley on the span from the 21st degree of Capricornus to the 20th degree of Aquarius (pdf p161); on the decans and the elemental attribution (pdf p139).

quotes.quote: He rules from the 21st degree of Capricornus to the 20th degree of Aquarius.
instead of assigning the three decans of each sign to one card, the influence begins with the last decan of one Sign and continues to the second decan of the next.
It might well be expected that the elemental attribution would harmonize with the Zodiacal attribution; but it is not so.

sections.title: Character
sections.line: Crowley on the character of the Prince of Swords (pdf p162).

quotes.quote: A person thus symbolized is purely intellectual.
